content: Bubbletea multi-pane: compose sub-models each implementing Update(tea.Msg)(Model,tea.Cmd) and View() string. Parent app model embeds sub-models and routes messages. Focus tracked via layoutState or a focused-pane enum. tea.FocusMsg/tea.BlurMsg signal focus changes. Three-pane Miller Columns common pattern (left/center/right). Keyboard events routed to focused sub-model only. Minimum terminal size enforcement (80x24). State changes flow through explicit messages making it testable. revdiff is a real-world example with sidepane sub-package and model.go/view.go/handlers.go split.
